plan: With a private value of $46, my goal is to maximize potential profit. Since this is a single round with no prior history, I'll use a strategic bidding approach. I want to bid high enough to likely win, but not so high that I eliminate my potential profit margin. Given the $0-$49 uniform distribution, other bidders' values are also unpredictable. I'll bid slightly below my true value to preserve some potential profit if I win.

My private value is $28. Since this is a single round with no prior history, I'll aim to bid strategically. I want to maximize potential profit by bidding slightly below my true value.
